title: In Guangzhou, even fruit is luxury — Lychee King season | Guangzhou Ate First EP1
description:
Where else does fruit get its own throne?

Real footage from Guangzhou: "Lychee King" season at a fruit counter, a traditional bakery still making radish cake the slow way, and a skyline that never stops growing — China's food capital in 22 seconds.
